title: euonymus japonicus f. albomarginatus
intro: Euonymus japonicus f. albomarginatus, commonly known as Silver King or White Spire, is a cultivar of the Euonymus japonicus plant, known for its striking white-edged leaves. The health benefits of Euonymus japonicus f. albomarginatus include its potential in reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and acting as an antioxidant. The plant is said to have therapeutic actions such as calming the nervous system, reducing anxiety and stress, and promoting a restful sleep. The bioactive constituents of Euonymus japonicus f. albomarginatus include iridoid glycosides, alkaloids, and flavonoids, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
